task: T-004 (LiMnPO4 candidate vs LiFePO4 baseline on voltage; D-004 option A, kickoff 2026-10-22)

seeds.note: CHGNet inference is deterministic; seed recorded for completeness

input_provenance: pipeline/data/raw/<id>/provenance.json (stage 1, MP db 2026.09.28; mp-18997 pulled 2026-10-22 by stage1_pull_t004.py with the kickoff polymorph pick rule)

settings.arrangements_policy: one arrangement per lithiation state: x=1 uses the pulled MP structure as-is; x=0 removes all Li from the same cell (vacancy-ordered framework). RQ-2 cap recorded in manifest: 4 Li sites per 4-fu olivine cell = 24 possible orderings; this run relaxes 1 per state.
settings.li_reference: bcc Li, conventional 2-atom cell a=3.5093 A, relaxed with the same model/optimizer/fmax/cell relaxation. Never a database Li energy (D-rule).

rq_flags.RQ-2: arrangement cap: 1 per state (24 possible orderings per 4-fu olivine cell)
rq_flags.RQ-3: magnetic ordering: CHGNet internal magmom prediction (assign_magmoms=true); no explicit FM/AFM constraint

comparison.baseline_run_value_ref: run-20261021-t003-g1 predicted 3.4239 V; this run re-relaxes the baseline for a within-run comparison
